slash_commands.name: status
slash_commands.description: Show runtime status for this service.

slash_commands.name: session
slash_commands.description: Show details for the current session.

slash_commands.name: model
slash_commands.description: Show the active model provider, brain backend, and context estimate.

slash_commands.name: effort
slash_commands.description: Show or override reasoning effort for the current session; use default to clear the override.

positional_args.name: effort
positional_args.description: One of none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or default.

slash_commands.name: archive
slash_commands.description: Archive the current Crew brain session without replacing it.

slash_commands.name: new
slash_commands.description: Archive the current session and create a fresh replacement session.

slash_commands.name: reload-mcp
slash_commands.description: Reload MCP tools for the current session profile surface.
